result.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
result.fit_rationale: Moderate-to-strong partial fit. The role values senior software engineering for building RL evaluation environments, and the candidate brings deep Python, historical C++, performance optimization, large-scale systems experience, and practical AI/LLM project work. However, there is no direct evidence of RL environment construction, Docker/GDB/ASan/FFmpeg tooling, CI/CD/DevOps workflows, or benchmark/evaluation framework development, which are core to this job.
strengths: Expert Python and historical expert C++ with real performance optimization evidence, including optimizing C++/OCci processing with roughly 95% less hardware at Sabre.
Strong performance engineering, bottleneck analysis, and data-quality/debugging-oriented work across APM, telemetry ETL, and forecasting systems.
Practical AI project evidence: agentic job-search pipeline with LLM scoring/quality gates and an AWS lakehouse with Text-to-SQL agent.
Experience with large-scale data systems, including migrating 200+ MySQL nodes to Oracle RAC, supporting the distributed-codebase preference.
gaps: No direct evidence of building Reinforcement Learning environments or evaluating AI model solutions.
No explicit production experience with Docker, GDB, AddressSanitizer, FFmpeg, Git workflows, or CI/CD/DevOps.
Limited evidence for codebase refactoring, feature development, and rigorous code-review participation.
Profile is more capacity/observability engineering than general software engineering, so algorithms/software architecture depth is not strongly documented.

Translate current AI-assisted report automation and the AI agentic pipeline/lakehouse projects into evidence for AI evaluation workflows and quality gates. Add a brief section on reproducibility and correctness: ETL validation/anomaly checks, forecasting model validation, and agentic pipeline quality gates.
